body:
I feel like here we'll need to introduce the concept of "shared widgets". I don't think we can assume that whenever the attribute names are identical (`color` in this case), we can sum the facet counts.

Another solution would be to pass the `scopedResults` to the `transformItems` function. We already had some use cases for accessing search parameters or the UI state in this function. That would make it possible to achieve this behavior user-land.
